svg.title: The code of the hooks
svg.desc: MkDocs, the scripts and the workflows run .github/mkdocs_project.py, which passes on what they ask for to the modules of .github/hub/. Each module imports only those below it. The event hooks of MkDocs use the files of the address and what a project works with, which use the releases, the search and the cards. The fix of the catalog bot uses its comparison and the cards, and the comparison uses what a project works with and the cards. The check of the built website and the watch of the live websites use the files of the address and what they read of a website, and the check also the Releases page. Everything rests on the reader, the web and the catalog.
